title: Update website color scheme to pastel colors

requirements.summary: Replace the current vibrant gradient color scheme with a soft pastel color palette throughout the entire website
acceptanceCriteria: All vibrant gradients are replaced with soft pastel colors
Color palette maintains consistency across all pages and components
Pastel colors provide sufficient contrast for readability
UI elements like buttons, inputs, and cards use pastel color variations

file_operations.description: Replace the current vibrant gradient color scheme (coral/orange to purple/pink) with a soft pastel color palette. Update CSS custom properties and gradient definitions to use pastel colors (e.g., soft pink, lavender, mint, peach) while maintaining sufficient contrast for readability. Ensure all background gradients, text highlights, and accent colors follow the pastel theme.

Update Tailwind configuration to define pastel color variants in the theme.extend.colors section. Replace any vibrant color definitions with pastel equivalents (e.g., pastel-pink, pastel-purple, pastel-blue, pastel-green) to ensure consistency across utility classes used throughout the application.

Review and update any inline color classes or style props to use the new pastel color palette. Replace vibrant gradient backgrounds and accent colors with pastel equivalents while maintaining the existing layout structure and component hierarchy.
